interest: Docket of prewar monthly political reports on Japan, showing how they were cross-filed with foreign-relations files.
overview: Two-page docket for 894.00 P.R. listing Grew's monthly political reports on Japan, December 1939 to August 1941.

subfiles.about: A two-page Department of State list of papers recording and routing monthly political reports on conditions in Japan from December 1939 through August 1941.
subfiles.summary: Docket of monthly political reports on Japan by Grew, December 1939 to August 1941, sub-numbers 145 to 164.
subfiles.title: Department of State List of Papers: Monthly Political Reports - Japan
